findings.description: This build is negative for the delimiter shapes themselves: an explicit find(' ') plus a no-further-space guard rejects a second space, and token(method) rejects TAB, so every odd delimiter form is a 400. The shift is one step later: the upstream target is rebuilt from the decoded path, so %20 survives as a raw space and the upstream split() sees four tokens. Control /exec/exec?cmd=whoami gives a three-token line; /exec/exec%20?cmd=whoami gives GET /exec ?cmd=whoami, four tokens. Precondition: a rewriting proxy_pass, unauthenticated single request.
findings.title: A decoded space inside a rewritten proxy_pass target becomes a raw space in the upstream request line, four upstream tokens, while the ingress delimiter count stays strict

limitations: All RCE is RCE on the upstream host
